newsitem.title: USA: California nuclear unit may shut Thurs for 2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: California nuclear unit may shut Thurs for 2 weeks.

text.p: Unit two at the San Onofre nuclear generating plant near San Clemente, Calif., may shut on Thursday for two weeks of maintenance work on a reactor coolant pump, said a spokesman for Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, the plant's operator.
The 1,070-megawatt unit is still scheduled to begin a 65 day refueling outage at the end of November, said spokesman Ray Golden.

He noted that differential pressure indications for water seals on one of the unit's four reactor pumps are approaching maintenance levels and may need to be repaired before the upcoming refueling outage.
San Onofre's 1,070-MW unit three continues to operate normally. It is next scheduled to shut for refueling on April 1, 1997.
